title: Python DIO commits SCHC policy before RPL admission succeeds
description: DodagState.process_authenticated_dio calls LinkLayer.accept_authenticated_schc_dio first, replacing peer compression policy and invalidating sessions, then process_dio may reject/ignore the DIO as stale/incomparable version, poison, self/root, non-parent, or invalid ETX. A replay-fresh but unusable signed DIO can churn policy and tear down active sessions. Prevalidate DODAG candidacy without mutation or make Link+DODAG admission one atomic transaction; rejected DIOs must leave policy/sessions unchanged. Add stale/poison/non-parent/invalid-ETX and concurrent admission tests.
notes:
Security review found a further transaction gap: compatibility is read, Link DIO elevation returns only sender_iid, then authenticated.dio is reread and routing state mutated after the lease. Same-generation peer-policy replacement or key retirement can admit stale evidence. Detached DIO parsing, current peer-policy issuance validation, and DODAG mutation must commit inside one elevation/lease transaction.
Independent rereview confirmed atomic version transitions must invalidate both sender and receiver state/tombstones; receiver half was initially missed and has now been fixed.
